pricing.title: We show you the bill, not the headline.
pricing.body: The industry writes “from 2,999” and adds the rest at checkout. We compute one all-in figure per person, server-side, with every mandatory fee already in it, and we tell you what falls outside it and roughly what that costs.
pricing.l1b: Computed for your actual party size and departure city, not a twin-share teaser.
pricing.l2b: Visa, tourist tax, optional excursions. Named and estimated, at the same weight as the inclusions.
pricing.l3b: No countdown timers. No “three people are viewing this”. If seats are limited the number is the real number.

story.c1: It starts the night before, when nobody can sleep.
story.c2: Somewhere past the third hour, the arguing stops and everyone just looks.
story.c3: You booked a week away. What you brought home was one dinner that ran until midnight.
story.c4: Nobody photographs the price. They photograph this.
story.turn: So the only thing left to get right is the number.
story.turn_b: Every figure on this site is the complete cost for the party you tell us about, computed before you ask. What sits outside it is named and estimated, at the same weight as what sits inside.

about.title: About us
about.lede: A small agency that shows you the whole price before you ask for it.
about.p1: We build a small number of trips each season and sell them properly. Flights, hotel, transfers and the things people forget, priced together for the group that is actually travelling.
about.h2: Why the prices look different here
about.p2: Every competitor in this category hides the same three things: the total, what is excluded, and who they are. We show all three. The number on a card is what the whole party pays, and anything outside it is listed with what it costs and where that figure came from.
about.p3: You do not book on this site. You send an enquiry and a person answers it, because a trip for six people over school holidays is a conversation, not a checkout. We answer between 09:00 and 21:00 Riyadh time, usually well inside the same day.
about.p4: This site was designed in Arabic and the English follows from it, rather than the other way round. The type, the layout and the direction were all built that way from the start.
about.p5: These packages are specimen data, and every card says so. They are invented under an invented house brand to show how the interface works. There are no reviews, no ratings and no licence numbers on this site, because on an invented catalogue those would be fabricated records rather than a weaker design.
